scope: Same twenty fixed v0.2 geometries; flat 3+1 model, known density and fixed external labels. Fresh count draws only.
primary_gate: At the unchanged 16x budget, every geometry must have one-sided Clopper-Pearson certificate-availability lower bound >=0.90, with Bonferroni alpha=0.05/20. Original-budget comparisons are secondary.
confidence_region: Unchanged v0.3 region sum D(y_i||lambda_i)<=48; noncoverage <=2^30 exp(-24). True model means also satisfy the two exact target-norm constraints.
estimator: F=q+k_p r_p+k_q r_q; the norm residuals vanish on the model. Candidate coefficients minimize the local weighted gradient norm, are quantized with denominator 2^20 and capped at magnitude 16.
bound: Full square-root remainder plus exact inverse matrix remainder. A regularized spectral absolute value of the 2x2 coefficient matrix gives a PSD majorant; its factor yields an 8-dimensional norm bound.
selection: Validate all positive geometric and v0.4 candidates at 60 digits. Select a geometric certificate if it passes, otherwise a v0.4 certificate, otherwise HOLD. Both use the same confidence event.
comparison: v0.4 on identical fresh observations, with every positive candidate independently validated. Record geometric-only and fallback availability separately.
audit: Exact seed replay, independent corrected-center interval solves, exact certificate inequalities and known-target checks, first and last distinct selected certificates per nonempty cell at 90 digits, 256 ellipsoid-boundary directions per selected audit case with coefficients held fixed.
development_data: Archived v0.4 observations only; development candidates are not fresh validation.
no_claims: closing the original-budget gate by testing a higher budget
